description: This file implements the main recipe listing page for a web application using the Qwik framework. It manages URL-based search, filtering, pagination, and rendering of recipe cards with loading and error states.

methods.name: parseQuery
methods.description: Builds a RecipeQuery object from the current URL parameters.

methods.name: buildUrlWithParams
methods.description: Constructs a new URL string by updating provided query parameters while preserving other URL parts.
